name: fix-psi-trigger-loop
title: Fix PSI trigger busy loop and unit start limits
description: Fix the PSI trigger busy loop that keeps the daemon suspended and burns CPU on kernels where a fired trigger fd stays readable: close and re-arm watches on a cooldown, ignore zero readings, and move StartLimitIntervalSec/StartLimitBurst to [Unit]. Release 2611.14.2 and validate the update path on oracle-sg-tx-forward.
creator: jdjingdian
